entries.subject: Placement

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.768675 solar radii from Lafarga et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1750 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.548ag512L/abstract). Mass 0.767 +/- 0.093 solar masses from Stassun et al. (2019), AJ 158, 138 (TIC v8.2), the mass of TIC 237099296 (VizieR IV/39/tic82); no NASA Exoplanet Archive row gives one, nor does Gaia DR3 FLAME (https://doi.org/10.3847/1538-3881/ab3467). Temperature 4683.75 K from Lafarga et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1750 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 4,683.75 K and log g 4.55 (u1 0.741, u2 0.049): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
